propositions: _repair_ticket bypasses rebuild_with_restore and calls rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log directly, so deleted SNAPSHOT sources are not restored during per-ticket repair
rebuild_with_restore is the documented single entrypoint for repair but _repair_ticket does not use it, creating a behavioral divergence between the two repair paths

rebuild_with_restore must accept a keyword-only no_commit parameter and forward it to rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log to preserve the batch repair contract that defers commits until after the whole batch
_repair_ticket must route its rebuild through rebuild_with_restore and surface restored filenames in the disp dict that the caller already consumes
An import cycle exists because fsck_repair imports fsck_restore at module bottom, so _repair_ticket must use a function-local import of rebuild_with_restore

A held-out test must verify that a ticket with a deleted SNAPSHOT source is recovered when repair runs via _repair_ticket, and that the no_commit=True contract and idempotent double-restore behavior are preserved
